_comment: NX cursor shape table. Coordinates are in the 32x32 SVG canvas.
The canvas is oversized relative to the nominal cursor size (24) exactly
like breeze_cursors/cursors_scalable, so glass edges and drop shadows have
room to bleed. tools/build_cursors.py scales hotspots by px/32.
'frames'/'delay' mark animated shapes: the build rotates every element
carrying transform="rotate(0 cx cy)" through a full turn.
RIM WEIGHT: the near-white outline is a centred stroke of 0.9 canvas units
(0.85 on badges and secondary parts, 0.8 on small details). That works out
to ~1px at nominal 24 and ~2px at nominal 48/64 - the same weight as
breeze_cursors. Do not push it past 1.0; it reads as a border, not a rim.
Glyph strokes (the help '?', the alias curve, the spinner arcs) are not
rims and keep their own heavier weights.
